rounds.text: Hi-Tech Pipes Ltd presents a compelling value opportunity because it trades at a modest price-to-book ratio of 1.40x on a book value of ₹ 61.6 [E2], which drops even further to 1.29x against a sector benchmark of 2.37x [E7]. This asset-backed discount is reinforced by a favorable price-to-earnings multiple of 22.61x, undercutting the broader sector benchmark of 25.04x [E6]. Operational efficiency further justifies appreciation, demonstrated by a positive return on assets of 3.76% that vastly outperforms the sector benchmark of -0.8% [E8]. With the market capitalization sitting at ₹ 1,746 Cr [E3], the current equity price languishes near the bottom of its yearly trajectory at just 27 percent of the way up its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: the dividend yield is nominal at 0.03% [E4].
